summary: Consolidated asset redistribution and temporary access provisioning for Marketing ↔ Product floor swap
description: Issue summary: Marketing and Product teams are swapping assigned open-plan sections across floors in the EU-West office on 2026-03-18. Facilities needs a consolidated plan to collect, re-label, and redistribute ~28 assets (monitors, docks, standing desks parts, spare chairs), plus issue 6 temporary visitor badges for cross-floor contractors. Impact: downtime risk for 2 cross-functional teams if assets are delayed or access is not provisioned. Environment: eu-west office, floors 4 and 7, midday move window (10:00–15:00). Request: coordinate palletized pickup, interoffice courier (multi-leg), temporary access cards for contractors and movers, inventory reconciliation sheet, and final signoff with team leads. Acceptance criteria: all assets picked up from floor 7 by 12:30, delivered to floor 4 by 14:30; temporary badges activated and tested by 09:30; inventory signed off by both team leads before 16:00. Special handling: 6 monitors boxed with anti-static wrap; two SSD laptops must travel with a locked courier pouch; standing-desk frames tagged for reassembly. See proposed schedule and vendor notes below.
work_items: Confirm pallet dimensions and weight with BoxForward courier (deadline 2026-03-12)
Create and print asset tags (red/blue) for Product and Marketing sets
Prepare 6 temporary contractor badges (expiring 2026-03-19) and register in badge system
Coordinate locked pouch for SSD laptops and verify chain-of-custody form
Arrange staggered delivery window to avoid freight elevator contention
Finalize inventory reconciliation sheet and send to team leads for pre-check

investigation_notes: Initial inventory shows 28 tracked assets: 12 monitors, 8 docking stations, 4 standing-desk crossbeams, 4 spare chairs, 2 SSD laptops (high value). Discrepancy discovered in previous move log: one monitor tag (SN-FR-091) missing — recommend physical verification pre-pickup. Risk: freight elevator maintenance on 2026-03-17 could force alternate window. Mitigation: confirm elevator status 2026-03-15 and hold back a contingency courier slot.
planned_resolution: Complete multi-leg pickup on 2026-03-18 morning slot; temporary badges active by 09:00; inventory reconciliation completed on same day. If elevator is unavailable, fallback to evening window 18:00–20:00 with on-call courier.
acceptance_criteria: All listed assets transferred and verified by both team leads
Temporary badges issued and tested for door access
Chain-of-custody form completed for SSD laptops
No outstanding missing SN entries in inventory sheet
